latestVersion.changelog: Send real postal mail through PostalForm using machine payments: prepare/validate print-and-mail payloads, submit `POST /api/machine/orders`, settle x402 payment with any compatible wallet client (purl or custom), and poll fulfillment through completion. Use when an agent must autonomously mail a letter/document as real physical mail with strong first-pass correctness and idempotent retry behavior.
